# `Browser.Gamepad`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Gamepad — a session-stream delivering gamepad connect/disconnect
events and polled button/axis state frames, typed records, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js`
ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` starts or stops the gamepad watch, and
inbound `JsMsg` frames carry connect/disconnect events and polled state
snapshots. Both cross the same seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as
every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:gamepad`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.Gamepad` path prefix via
`WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level app's
`[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Gamepad.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `watch` starts the continuous stream
    as an outbound `Cmd`, `stopWatch` ends it, and `events` is the inbound
    subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed `GamepadEvent`. The
    inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability becomes a typed variant,
    never a silently dropped frame.

## `GamepadEvent`

A typed gamepad event delivered by the watch stream.

  * `GamepadConnected index id` — a gamepad plugged in or recognised.
    `index` is the browser-assigned slot (0..3); `id` is the browser-assigned
    identifier string (vendor/product, e.g. `"Xbox 360 Controller (XInput…)"`).
  * `GamepadDisconnected index` — a gamepad removed or lost.
  * `GamepadState index buttons axes` — a polled state snapshot for one
    connected gamepad. `buttons` lists whether each physical button is
    pressed (Gamepad API order); `axes` lists each axis value in -1.0..1.0
    (Gamepad API order). Delivered once per animation frame for each
    connected gamepad.
  * `GamepadUnavailable` — the Gamepad API is absent in this browser context.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a continuous gamepad stream; connect/disconnect events and
polled state frames are delivered on the `events` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

The JS host registers `gamepadconnected` / `gamepaddisconnected` listeners and
starts a `requestAnimationFrame` poll that snapshots `navigator.getGamepads()`
on each frame. A missing Gamepad API replies immediately with `Unavailable`
rather than silently failing.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:gamepad`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort Gamepad ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `stopWatch`

```ipe
stopWatch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`stopWatch` — stop the active gamepad poll and remove the event listeners.
A no-op when no watch is active. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `events`

```ipe
events : (GamepadEvent -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`events toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a `GamepadEvent`
— every variant is covered, so no gamepad event can ever be silently dropped.
